caption: The same stored value is read three ways. Double quotes keep it one word, single quotes keep the text literal, and an unquoted value can split on spaces: if NAME='Asha Rao', the unquoted echo prints two words.

spec.title: Quoting decides expansion

nodes.label: Asha
nodes.note: one word here; a value with spaces would split
